name: round-27-amrap-timer
description: A focused Cindy and AMRAP pace timer with dynamic round targets and shareable results.
author: Round 27

scripts.test: npm run build && node --test tests/rendered-html.test.mjs tests/source-sync.test.mjs
scripts.mobile:sync: npm run mobile:build && cap sync android
scripts.android:debug: npm run mobile:sync && npm run mobile:icons && node scripts/run-gradle.mjs assembleDebug
scripts.android:bundle: npm run mobile:sync && npm run mobile:icons && node scripts/run-gradle.mjs bundleRelease
scripts.desktop:portable: npm run desktop:build && electron-builder --win portable --x64 --config.directories.output=release/portable --publish never
scripts.desktop:installer: npm run desktop:build && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --config.directories.output=release/installer --publish never
scripts.desktop:windows: npm run desktop:portable && npm run desktop:installer
scripts.desktop:mac: npm run desktop:build && node scripts/build-macos-icon.mjs && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --config.directories.output=release/macos --publish never
scripts.check:release: npm run test && npm run mobile:sync && node --test tests/mobile-build.test.mjs && npm run check:desktop
scripts.lint: eslint . --ignore-pattern dist --ignore-pattern .next --ignore-pattern mobile-dist --ignore-pattern desktop-dist --ignore-pattern desktop-resources --ignore-pattern release --ignore-pattern android
